title: A contract objective is withheld from the contract's own source and ends when its contract is no longer ACTIVE
summary: Option A per planner: scorer ignores self-sourced contracts (the only production producer makes them), contract-serving project ends when its contract is not ACTIVE via a shared objective_outcome; corpus before 2 self-targeted projects, after 0; 31 tests, controls fail 3/13/1; typed target_entity_id dropped
